name: @absolutejs/machines-bridge
description: Shop-LAN bridge agent for @absolutejs/commerce-machines: polls your app for print/embroidery jobs and delivers them to a hot folder, a printer port (TCP 9100), an IPP printer or the OS print queue. No arbitrary command execution.
author: Alex Kahn

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build ./src/index.ts ./src/cli.ts --root ./src --outdir dist --target bun --external @absolutejs/commerce-machines --external '@absolutejs/commerce-machines/*' && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --project tsconfig.json && chmod +x dist/cli.js
scripts.release: bun run check:package && npm publish --access public --tag beta
scripts.check:package: bun run format && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
